build_laguna_mlp: build a dense MLP layer with separate gate, up, and down projections for Laguna model inference
build_laguna_moe: build a sparse MoE block with sigmoid routing and an optional shared expert for Laguna
build_laguna_attention: build an attention layer with softplus output gating, per-layer sliding window, and QK normalization
build_laguna_decoder_layer: build a decoder layer that conditionally uses MoE or dense MLP based on layer index and config
run_laguna_inference: run causal LM inference with the LagunaForCausalLM model using vLLM pipeline parallelism and expert mapping
